['Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH '].company_description: Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH is a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell plc and operates in the oil and gas industry in Germany. The company is involved in the production, refining, and distribution of petroleum products. Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH offers a range of products including gasoline, diesel, heating oil, lubricants, and bitumen. They also provide services such as fuel cards and convenience store offerings at their retail locations.

['Deutsche Lufthansa AG '].company_description: Deutsche Lufthansa AG, commonly known as Lufthansa, is the flag carrier of Germany. It is the second-largest airline in Europe in terms of passengers carried. Lufthansa is a founding member of the Star Alliance, the world's largest airline alliance. In addition to its own services, Lufthansa owns subsidiary passenger airlines such as Austrian Airlines, Swiss International Air Lines, Brussels Airlines, and Eurowings. The company also owns aviation-related companies like Lufthansa Technik and LSG Sky Chefs. Lufthansa has a fleet of over 700 aircraft and its main operations base is at Frankfurt Airport. The company was founded in 1953 and has its headquarters in Cologne.
